scope.description: One process, one real single-node cluster with TrailingLogs=0, SnapshotThreshold=10000 and SnapshotInterval=100ms. After the node becomes leader one command is applied and a user Snapshot() is run, and store last index, snapshot index, applied index, stored-snapshot count and shouldSnapshot are recorded. Six samples are then taken 200ms apart, each recording elapsed time, store last index, snapshot index, applied index, stored-snapshot count and shouldSnapshot, so any growth in the count is attributable to the node's own snapshot loop while no client command is applied.

basis.prefix: inmemConfig supplies the defaults; TrailingLogs=0 makes the user snapshot's compaction trim up to the snapshot index and the large threshold makes the pre-state verdict false, while the 100ms interval makes the automatic loop fire several times inside the sampling window. MakeCluster(1, t, conf) starts the real node over InmemTransport with InmemStore logs and stable state and the cluster helper's in-memory snapshot store; the test waits for Leader before applying. No client command is issued after the emptied state, so the applied index is a constant control: any change in the stored-snapshot count while the applied index stays fixed comes from the node's own snapshot scheduling. All operands are package-internal reads of the runtime object plus the snapshot store's List(); no production logic is modified.

before.description: One process, one real single-node cluster with TrailingLogs=0, SnapshotThreshold=10000 and SnapshotInterval=1h. After the node becomes leader one command is applied and a user Snapshot() is run, then store last index, snapshot index, applied index, stored-snapshot count and shouldSnapshot are recorded. The production takeSnapshot is then invoked twice, and after each invocation the same operands are recorded together with the returned snapshot-id presence and any error.

revision_reason: The previous execution triggered the snapshot path directly and could not speak to the cadence; this revision shortens SnapshotInterval to 100ms and samples over time so the automatic runSnapshots loop, not the harness, decides when snapshots are taken.
